description: The largest closed models, served only through a provider API. Best quality on hard tasks; highest price; data leaves your network; deprecation on the provider's schedule.
A model whose weights you can download and run yourself, under a model license that may or may not be permissive.
Open source AI (per the OSI definition) needs weights, code and training-data information under terms allowing any use. Most open models publish weights only, under custom licenses.
Roughly one to a few dozen billion parameters: fast, cheap, runs on one GPU or a device, strong on narrow tasks, weaker on knowledge and long reasoning.
Generates hidden reasoning tokens before answering. Better at math, code and planning; slower and more expensive, since reasoning tokens bill as output.
Spending more computation at inference (longer reasoning, sampling several answers) to improve quality, instead of training a bigger model.
Maps text or images to vectors so similar meanings are close. Powers semantic search and RAG; does not generate text.
Scores each query-document pair and reorders retrieved candidates for precision.
Karpathy's idea (emerging): a small model with strong reasoning and little memorized knowledge, which looks facts up through tools and retrieval.
